nodes.description: Owner address of the oneup ownership contract; gates transferOwnership through the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership two-step handover.
external onlyOwner function that writes the pending owner (newOwner); access controlled by msg.sender == owner.
external function requiring msg.sender == newOwner that finalizes ownership and clears newOwner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, admin checks, allowance spending and burn source.
Internal mapping of holder balances mutated by _transfer and _burn.
Internal nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount mutated by _approve.
Mutable total supply reduced by _burn and used as the denominator in getPercentOfTrade.
Floor supply (100 ether) below which burns must not push the supply.
public approval entrypoint delegating to internal _approve.
public allowance increase using SafeMath.add then _approve.
public allowance decrease using SafeMath.sub then _approve.
internal balance-moving routine with zero-address checks and Transfer event.
internal burn routine that reduces _totalSupply and _balances while enforcing MinSupply.
internal allowance-consuming transfer used by the public transferFrom.
internal allowance writer with zero-address validation and Approval event.
Public token name string, overwritten in the constructor with a URL.
Public token symbol, overwritten in the constructor with 1UP.
Timestamp marker (first transfer timestamp + 15 minutes) defining the anti-whale launch window.
Public decimals value, hard-coded to 18.
Cumulative burned token counter updated by burn and transfer.
Boolean latch that arms the 15 minute launch window on the very first transfer.
Admin address exempt from buy caps and the 3% max trade restriction.
external burn entrypoint burning from msg.sender and increasing totalBurnt.
internal percentage helper computing numTokens*1000/_totalSupply with an unchecked multiplication.
Main transfer override enforcing launch caps, randomized burn and admin exemption.
transferFrom override that bypasses all transfer restrictions by calling _transferFrom directly.
internal pseudo-random generator seeded with block.timestamp, block.difficulty and msg.sender modulo 7.
Payable fallback that immediately forwards msg.value back to msg.sender.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for launch window checks and randomness.
External value call msg.sender.transfer(_amount) at the end of the payable receive fallback.
Unchecked numTokens * 1000 multiplication that can overflow and silently wrap.
block.timestamp < firstBlock branch that changes transfer limits based on miner-controlled time.
Burn percentage derived from predictable on-chain entropy (timestamp, difficulty, sender).

edges.reason: approve forwards value/spender to internal _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
_transferFrom performs the balance move via _transfer.
_transferFrom consumes allowance via _approve on msg.sender.
_transfer debits and credits _balances.
_burn subtracts the burned value from _balances.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_burn requires _totalSupply.sub(value) > MinSupply.
burn calls super._burn for msg.sender.
burn accumulates into totalBurnt.
burn uses msg.sender as the unvalidated burn source.
transfer calls getPercentOfTrade to enforce the 3% cap.
transfer requests a burn percentage from randNumber.
transfer burns the randomized portion before forwarding tokens.
transfer forwards the unburnt remainder via super._transfer.
transfer arms and reads firstBlock for the launch window.
transfer latches firstTransfer on the first call.
transfer branches on block.timestamp to toggle whale limits.
transfer exempts AdminAddress from caps based on caller identity.
transfer adds the burned amount to totalBurnt.
transfer reads and mutates _balances through internal helpers and the whale cap check.
randNumber seeds its hash with block.timestamp.
randNumber mixes msg.sender into the pseudo-random seed.
getPercentOfTrade divides by the mutable _totalSupply.
receive refunds msg.value to the caller address.
receive performs an external value transfer to an untrusted caller address.
The external call target and amount both derive from msg.sender/msg.value.
numTokens * 1000 is executed without SafeMath and can overflow.
transfer behavior is conditioned on miner-controllable block.timestamp.
The burn percentage comes from predictable block data rather than secure randomness.
block.timestamp feeds the launch-window comparison in transfer.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied pending owner.
transferOwnership is guarded by msg.sender == owner via onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership reads and clears newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
transfer burns from and checks restrictions against msg.sender.
_transferFrom spends _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
transferFrom delegates entirely to _transferFrom.
oneup constructor sets the initial privileged owner.
isoneup constructor mints 1111 ether into _totalSupply.
isoneup constructor credits _balances[msg.sender].
isoneup constructor hard-codes the name state variable.
isoneup constructor hard-codes the symbol state variable.
isoneup constructor initializes totalBurnt.
isoneup constructor sets MinSupply to 100 ether.
isoneup constructor grants AdminAddress privileges to msg.sender.
isoneup constructor derives owner and admin from msg.sender.

_symbol argument is accepted by the constructor but ignored.
_amount parameter is burned from msg.sender.
numTokens feeds the unchecked multiplication that computes the trade percentage.
_recipient parameter receives the unburnt remainder.
_amount parameter is validated, burned against and split.
